geometry: A 14 by 14 translucent black rounded rectangle carries a one-unit white stroke: a rising cubic curve from approximately (2.5, 12) to (7.5, 3.5), followed by vertical and horizontal square-ended segments. The source background alpha is 166/255 over most pixels, with partially transparent corner pixels.
limitations: The smooth curve and antialiasing approximate the small raster original; corner coverage and individual edge pixels may differ. Native and 8x SVG renders were visually inspected.
